file_resources.description: A csv file describing the world happiness scores for many countries. the first line contains the columns (field names) of each following row. They are: 'Year','Rank','Country name','Ladder score','upperwhisker','lowerwhisker','Explained by: Log GDP per capita','Explained by: Social support','Explained by: Healthy life expectancy','Explained by: Freedom to make life choices','Explained by: Generosity','Explained by: Perceptions of corruption','Dystopia + residual'.
This file discusses the top countries in which to raise families.
